map.CRC 不是单一算法，而是一族参数组合：多项式、初始值、是否反转输入/输出、结果: CRC is not a single algorithm but a family of parameter combinations: polynomial, initial value, input/output reflection and final XOR. Change any one of them and the result changes. Common configurations include CRC-8, CRC-16/MODBUS, CRC-16/CCITT and CRC-32. Before comparing, confirm every parameter, not just the algorithm name.
